finding: A keyless tools/call of hf_fs search hf://docs with the vendor's own example question ("how to use LoRA adapters with PEFT", limit 3) on https://huggingface.co/mcp answered HTTP 200 on 2026-10-03 at 06:06:09Z with three documentation passages from peft v0.21.0, each with its section anchor, an excerpt and its page URL on huggingface.co/docs.
